name: FastSR-NeRF
definition: A pipeline that combines a hybrid NeRF model with a CNN-based super-resolution (SR) module to improve rendering efficiency on consumer devices by rendering at low resolution and upscaling, avoiding expensive training procedures like distillation or extra input features.
summary: FastSR-NeRF is a simple, end-to-end pipeline that boosts NeRF rendering efficiency on consumer hardware by training a lightweight NeRF at low resolution and upscaling outputs via a CNN, avoiding complex training procedures.
